en: I run the DAY-CARE service.\pWould you like me to raise one of\nyour POKéMON?
Fine, I'll look after your\n{STR_VAR_1} for a while.
Come see me in a while.
You're back already?\pYour {STR_VAR_1} needs to spend\nsome more time with me.
You owe me ¥{STR_VAR_2} for the return\nof this POKéMON.
Oh? You only have one POKéMON\nwith you.
If you leave me that POKéMON,\nwhat will you battle with?
Your {STR_VAR_1} has grown a lot.\nYes, quite a lot, I'd say.\pLet me see…\nBy level, it's grown by {STR_VAR_2}.\pAren't I great?
You can't take this POKéMON back\nif you've got no room for it.
